newsitem.title: USA: Republic to add finance ally -- Co-CEO.
newsitem.headline: Republic to add finance ally -- Co-CEO.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc Co Chief Executive Steve Berrard said on Thursday his deal-making company would strike an alliance with a well-known financial services group to help build its auto-finance business.

Berrard, responding to a shareholder's question at a special company meeting here, said Republic had no intention of buying a financial services company but intended to build a financing operation for its growing auto-retailing businesses without a major acquisition.
"That's a better use of our capital," Berrard said.

He did not identify the ally with which Republic is negotiating but said the partner would handle the backroom operations of Republic's consumer finance business. He said Republic expected to reach an agreement by March 31.
Republic's shareholders earlier approved the roughly $646 million stock acquisition of AutoNation USA, a used car retailing business with ambitious expansion plans.

Republic is a diversified services group led by Florida billionaire Wayne Huizenga and has in recent months bought several car dealerships and the leading US auto-rental businesses Alamo Rent-a-Car and National Car Rental.
